messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - Billing metering anomaly detected: token_count delta > 20% vs baseline for a subset of live customers. Auto-run diagnostics started.

sre-oncall: on it. seeing an alert for consumer lag on token-ingest topic. @alice can you confirm metrics? :eyes:

alice: looking now - consumer_lag for token-ingest consumer group is 118k, consumer throughput dropped ~80% around 02:10 UTC.

alice: quick query on the replay queue: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM token_queue WHERE status='pending' AND created_at > now() - interval '6 hours'` -> `345,212` rows

bob: that's a lot. any deploys around that time? I'm checking eng-releases timeline.

kate: no infra deploys in that window. network flaps in us-west1 around 02:08 but services recovered. could be an emitter backpressure.

sre-oncall: can we confirm whether downstream metering aggregator applied partial windows or skipped receipts? kate, can you tail aggregator logs for errors?

kate: tail shows repeated "KV timeout while writing batch" and `WARN: partial-emit` on metering-aggregator-02 at 02:11-02:14.

billing-engineer: from billing side we see a spike in overage flag events for accounts A123, B987. Those flags are driven by delta counts that look inflated once ingestion resumed. Suspect double-count when backlog replayed.

sre-oncall: hypothesis: consumer stalled, backlog replayed while a retry path dedup wasn't active, causing duplicates and inflated counts.

alice: I can run idempotency check - samples show repeated event_ids for some customers in backlog. running script now: `python tools/check_duplicates.py --topic token-ingest --sample 1000`

alice: result: ~1.9% duplicates in sample; duplicates concentrated in emitter shard 7.

billing-engineer: duplicate rate explains the inflated deltas and overage flags. immediate mitigation: disable automated overage-flags for affected window and mark those accounts for manual review/credits.

sre-oncall: agree. I'll flip the internal flag. `POST /internal/billing/flags/auto_disable` payload: `{"reason":"ingest-duplication-2025-11-02","window_start":"2025-11-02T02:00:00Z","window_end":"2025-11-02T03:00:00Z"}` - doing this now.

ryan: pls also pause customer-facing alerts while we investigate so we don't spam customers.

billing-engineer: pausing alerts and creating ticket for manual reconciliation. ticket: BILL-4521.

sre-oncall: root cause next steps: 1) pin emitter shard 7 to restart with dedupe patch, 2) reprocess backlog with idempotency enforced, 3) run a dry-run of billing counts before committing. I'll own shard restart.

alice: restarting emitter shard 7 with `--enable-dedupe` now. ETA 4m.

kate: after restart, consumer throughput picks up; backlog drain rate hitting expected throughput. monitoring drain curve.

bob: after reprocess and dedupe, we should validate totals vs last known good snapshot at 01:50 UTC. I'll prepare the validation query.

sre-oncall: communication: status update to customers affected (A123, B987 + 6 small accounts) drafted by @billing-engineer. Suggest include: what happened, what we did, expected remediation timeline, and that we will reconcile any incorrect charges.

billing-engineer: drafted msg posted to #billing-notifications for review.

ryan: any immediate SLA/customer impact? how many were charged incorrectly?

billing-engineer: preliminary: flags triggered for ~8 accounts, estimated incorrect charge window limited to 02:10-02:20 UTC. we'll know exact token deltas after reprocess.

sre-oncall: post-mortem items captured: improve dedupe during replays, add consumer-lag alert with upstream correlation, auto-silence customer alerts during ingest-replay windows, and a runbook for billing pause.

alice: reprocess finished, dry-run shows corrected counts; duplicates removed. committing reconciliation now.

billing-engineer: reconciliation committed to BILL-4521. We'll issue credits where needed and notify customers within 3 hours.

sre-oncall: incident resolved for now. assigning follow-ups: BILL-4521 (billing reconcile), ENG-PR-987 (dedupe fix), SRE-495 (lag alert enhancement). closing pager but keeping thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident CLOSED - severity downgraded to INFO. Summary: ingest consumer lag -> backlog replayed -> duplicates -> inflated billing deltas -> automated flags paused -> dedupe deployed -> backlog reprocessed -> reconciliation ticket created.
